The hammer was first class with Mick Jones throwing a PB to beat Paul Head with both men over 73 metres. Matt Douglas clocked the same time as in Match 1 to win the 'A' 400H.
Dave's 70.84m was best to date indicating a gradual return to fitness but he was still to take second to Mick, although he did get the valuable scalp of Newham's Paul Head.
Paul Head of Newham second. Julian Flynn then had an unexpected win in the long jump over Newham's Chris Davison who was destined for Kuala Lumpur.
